answer_1.quote: In level III, we aim to evaluate therapeutic response generation, the ultimate CBT efficacy—whether the model can effectively respond to patient speech during CBT sessions like the therapists.

answer_4.quote: We employ experts to conduct pairwise comparisons between the model generation and reference response under each criterion.
answer_4.guideline: Experts are instructed to label each pair with one of the following five labels: 1) A is much better than B, 2) A is slightly better than B, 3) A and B are about the same, 4) B is slightly better than A, and 5) B is much better than A. Labeling is done for each criterion defined, as well as an overall preference.
criteria: Suggest CBT-consistent goals and tasks that align with an individualized CBT case formulation
Emphasize concrete, actionable, and measurable goals
Engage the client and ask pertinent questions
Respect client autonomy and build rapport
